headline: Why AI-95 prices differ at different gas stations — the Antimonopoly Service's answer
summary: The Antimonopoly Service says AI-95 petrol price differences between filling station networks may reflect fuel purchase costs and supply terms. The statement was reported by 24.kg.
why: Retail fuel prices reflect wholesale purchase costs, supply contracts and competition, which affect consumer inflation and fuel retailers' margins.
original_headline: Почему цены на АИ-95 отличаются на разных АЗС — ответ Антимонопольной службы
